releases.body:
## 0.12.0

### Features

- Built-in embedding model, so semantic search needs no Ollama (a5bb9f5)
- Turn on semantic search by default when Ollama is running (588688a)

### Other changes

- Merge pull request #3 from bcmyguest/feat/semantic-search-default (9f0db2b)

Thanks @bcmyguest1, @github-actions[bot]

---

### npm

```shell
npm install -g smarter-compact@0.12.0
```

Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/smarter-compact/v/0.12.0

## 0.11.0

### Features

- Run the proxy in Docker by default with restart always (20e629c)

### Bug Fixes

- Run status through installed CLI (1991e43)

### Tests

- Expect the platform's path separator in the docker mount (ff67724)

### Other changes

- Merge pull request #2 from bcmyguest/feat/docker-proxy-default (3a45d55)

Thanks @bcmyguest1, @github-actions[bot]

---

### npm

```shell
npm install -g smarter-compact@0.11.0
```

Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/smarter-compact/v/0.11.0

## 0.10.1

### Bug Fixes

- **proxy:** Health probe waits 5 s (8580ca0)
- **proxy:** CLI waits 30 s for litellm to listen (b8a04cd)
- **search:** Test patterns against whole rows, not the first 20,000 chars (30d624f)

Thanks @github-actions[bot]

---

### npm

```shell
npm install -g smarter-compact@0.10.1
```

Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/smarter-compact/v/0.10.1

## 0.10.0

### Features

- Smarter-compact proxy restart (Linux, macOS, Windows) (deefcb5)
- Enable/disable log each step; -q for quiet (6d486f0)

### Bug Fixes

- Hide child process windows on Windows (#1) (80a3c0b)

### Documentation

- Upgrade section for proxy-backed agents (9e75075)
- Remote Control needs the proxy disabled (16001a0)
- ContextBench run G at v0.9.0, 85% cost saving; regenerate chart and demo (5402a01)

### CI

- Run tests on Windows; fix Windows failures (#1) (98f407a)

### Other changes

- Update README.md (3acd9b5)

Thanks @github-actions[bot]

---

### npm

```shell
npm install -g smarter-compact@0.10.0
```

Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/smarter-compact/v/0.10.0

## 0.9.0

### Features

- Ledger off by default (early stops on Terminal-Bench); research note with its source (c46f504)

### Bug Fixes

- Proxy notes go in their own system message (inline <system-reminder> where none exists); never user text (ae7d5e1)

Thanks @github-actions[bot]

---

### npm

```shell
npm install -g smarter-compact@0.9.0
```

Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/smarter-compact/v/0.9.0
